part.title: Quantization Algorithms, Kernel Implementation, and Inference Acceleration
part.readme_note: Students start with the mathematical reference, packing, and basic GEMM; quantization engineers can begin with strategy and kernel design. See the [quantization course design](docs/chapters/part-09-quantization/design.md) for the running experiment, tensor contracts, and acceptance criteria.

9.1.title: Low-precision representations and compute paths
9.1.topics: INT4/INT8 and FP8/FP4/MX formats; scales/zero points, rounding/saturation, granularity; storage/multiply/accumulation precision

9.2.title: Quantization algorithms
9.2.topics: Compare error objectives, calibration, clipping, rounding, error compensation, and equivalent transformations; GPTQ/AWQ as case studies, PTQ vs. QAT

9.3.title: Quantization strategies and precision allocation
9.3.topics: W/A/KV, weight-only vs. low-precision computation, static/dynamic, online/offline, layer/group/expert mixed precision, and workload awareness

9.4.title: Writing quantization and data-reordering kernels
9.4.topics: amax/reduction, Q/DQ, per-token/per-group scales, INT4 nibble packing, sign extension, reordering, and tail blocks

9.5.title: Weight-only GEMV and GEMM
9.5.topics: W4A16/W8A16, packed layouts, fused tiled dequantization, scale reuse, small-M decode, and large-M prefill

9.6.title: Low-precision GEMM and scaling
9.6.topics: W8A8/W4A8, conditional INT8/FP8/FP4 paths, dynamic activation quantization, group scaling, accumulation precision, zero-point compensation, and epilogues

9.7.title: Kernel fusion and tuning
9.7.topics: Norm/Act+Quant, GEMM epilogues, tiling, L2/shared-memory reuse, pipelines/double buffering, registers, split-K, and autotuning

9.8.title: KV quantization and attention integration
9.8.topics: KV formats/layouts, per-head/per-token scales, quantized writes/fused reads, low-bit dequantization, outlier layers, and long-context error

9.9.title: MoE expert quantization and grouped computation
9.9.topics: Per-expert precision/scales, activation quantization after routing, grouped GEMM, packed layouts, load imbalance, and communication integration

9.10.title: Integrating quantized kernels into vLLM
9.10.topics: QuantizationConfig → get_quant_method → create_weights → load → process_weights_after_loading → apply; layouts/sharding/dispatch/fallbacks

9.11.title: From kernel gains to end-to-end acceleration
9.11.topics: Microbenchmark → layer → model → serving; prefill/decode, numerical error and model quality, TTFT/TPOT/goodput, and amortizing preprocessing
